top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a complete, independently confirmed and mature discovery chain: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and its glucose-dependent insulinotropic action in humans, receptor biology, and large randomized outcome trials for glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov each hold a distinct part of the physiology within the three-person limit; the main residual risk is attribution (Mojsov priority, Habener group, Knudsen), which the citation can address by framing the prize around the physiology of the hormone and its active form. That risk does not justify no award.
